title: Created means appointed when said of the divinity
english: "The Lord created me" (Proverbs 8:22). If you take "he created me" as referring to the divinity, it means "he appointed me." So too: "Create a clean heart in me, O God" (Psalm 50:12 LXX; Psalm 51:12 in modern Hebrew numbering). And: "that he might create the two in himself" (Ephesians 2:15). For it is not in essence that he might create those who had already come into being, but that he might appoint them. Therefore he appointed me as the beginning of his providential and creative works. And to David he says: "I was appointed king by him."
translator_notes: True OET from PG 69 Greek; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
orientation: Cyril is opening his interpretation of Proverbs 8:22, explaining how the phrase 'The Lord created me' should be understood.
